headline: A restaurant website that *fills tables* — not just screens.
sub: Menus that load instantly, bookings in two taps, and local search working while you run service. Designed, engineered and live in as little as 48 hours.

painPoints.title: The PDF menu problem
painPoints.text: Hungry people don't pinch-zoom. A heavy PDF menu on a slow mobile connection is where cravings go to die — diners close the tab and pick the place next door.

painPoints.title: Booking means calling
painPoints.text: If the only way to reserve a table is a phone call during Friday rush, you're losing covers to whoever answers fastest. During service, that's rarely you.

painPoints.title: Invisible at the moment of hunger
painPoints.text: Diners search "restaurant near me" minutes before they decide. Without local SEO and structured data, Google simply doesn't put you in that conversation — no matter how good the food is.

mustHaves.title: A menu that loads before the craving fades
mustHaves.text: Server-rendered pages, no PDFs, 90+ Lighthouse performance targets. Your full menu, readable on any phone, on any network, instantly.

mustHaves.title: Reservations in two taps
mustHaves.text: Table booking and WhatsApp ordering built in. A diner sees the butter chicken, taps once to chat, taps again to confirm. Done.

mustHaves.title: A shot at "restaurant near me"
mustHaves.text: Structured data and local SEO in every build, so Google understands your cuisine, your neighbourhood and your hours — and puts you in the running when nearby stomachs growl.

mustHaves.title: Photography treated like the star it is
mustHaves.text: Your food photos, handled properly: sharp, colour-true, and compressed so they make mouths water without slowing the page down.

mustHaves.title: Google reviews, front and centre
mustHaves.text: Your best reviews surfaced on the site itself. Social proof works hardest at the exact moment someone is choosing where to eat — so we put it right there.

faqs.q: How fast can my restaurant website go live?
faqs.a: 48 hours on our Launch plan (₹7,999 / $99) for a sharp one-page site. Need a full menu, gallery and reservations across up to 5 pages? Growth (₹14,999 / $189) delivers in 4 days.

faqs.q: Can customers book a table or order directly from the site?
faqs.a: Yes. Every build includes WhatsApp integration and lead capture, so bookings and orders land straight in your chat. For full online ordering or a booking system, the Scale plan (₹24,999 / $329) covers it.

faqs.q: Does this actually bring in more diners?
faqs.a: The site we built for Spice Route Kitchen drove 2.4× more table bookings in 60 days. And we don't ask you to take our word for anything — our own live analytics and real-user Core Web Vitals are public at /proof.
